description: This is an Angular component for editing notes, allowing creation and update of note content, with inputs for the note model and outputs for save and cancel actions.

classes.name: NoteEditorComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing notes, with inputs, outputs, and form handling for note data.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Angular lifecycle hook that updates the local model when the input note changes.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles form submission and emits a save event with the note data if the form is valid.
